name: tr_scottie
caption:
IF SCOTTIE WAS A POKÉMON TRAINER, THIS IS HIS TEAM 🎮🏀

🥊 Riolu, the rookie: Rookie of the Year in year one
🔵 Lucario, the floor general: reads the whole floor, 5.1 assists a night
❄️ Weavile, the thief: 2.3 steals a game
⭐ Garchomp, the All-Star: 2024 and 2026
🔥 Incineroar, the heater: 41 points on 19-of-34 this season
🦖 Tyrantrum, the ace: our raptor, 23.5 points a night

Which one would you add? 👇
